pass.meaning: All declared phases stayed on one worker and one CARGO_TARGET_DIR, exited zero, and produced completion markers.

fail_closed.meaning: The bundle is not safe to reuse or promote because command wrapping, receipt coverage, worker identity, target-dir identity, local fallback rejection, exit status, or completion markers failed.

fail_closed_reasons: one or more phases are not rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR wrapped
one or more manifest phases did not produce receipts
phase receipts show worker identity drift
rch local fallback marker detected in phase output
one or more phases exited nonzero
one or more phases are missing completion markers

determinism.sorting: Phases and receipts are normalized by phase and command_id before hashing.
determinism.live_queries: The smoke path uses preserved receipts and does not query live rch state.
